title: Fix rejected drain PR #106 (agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-26)
description:
Drain PR #106 (branch `agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-26`) was NOT merged by pr-auto-review (llm-rejected).
Repair it ON THE EXISTING BRANCH — do NOT create a new branch or a second PR:
1. `git fetch origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-26 && git checkout agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-26`
2. Address EVERY reason below.
3. Run `npm test` until green.
4. Commit and `git push origin agent/drain/OS-curriculum-v2-conformance-26` — the reviewer re-reviews at the new SHA.

## Rejection reasons (verbatim)
- architectureCheck function incorrectly uses routedDomains from domains.json instead of counting actual routed domains
- tasksLast4Weeks calculation uses incorrect timestamp field name (should be 'timestamp' not 'ts')
- Missing error handling for invalid date parsing in performance log entries
